placebo.null_rule: recompute S_d = S ∩ {shifted X non-null}; re-evaluate BOTH A and B on S_d
placebo.primary: Bp: X_p = A @ Gamma_hat + circular_day_shift(E), E = X - A @ Gamma_hat, Gamma_hat fitted on TRAIN rows only
placebo.secondary_reported: Bt: circular day-shift of the whole X block (anti-conservative; report only)
placebo.stage2_rule: stage-1 rank only: #{placebo >= observed} <= 5 (never the effect size)
placebo.window_rule: shifts are circular WITHIN the stage window (dev placebos never read confirmation X)

placebo_shift_rule: S = {30 .. W_days-30}; 第1段階は np.linspace で等間隔に 200 個、第2段階は全数。乱数を使わないので K と窓から完全に再現できる
